Die Skizze liegt am besten auf einer Tan: The sketch should lie on a tangent plane of the cylinder: the profile is wrapped around the cylinder true to length. Text takes a few seconds.
Das Profil wird von der Skizzenebene aus: The profile is embossed or debossed starting from the sketch plane.
Die Linie wird in der Skizzenebene auf d: The line is widened to the thickness in the sketch plane and extruded by the height normal to the sketch (negative = other side).
Wandstärke 0 = Vollmaterial (z. B. Draht: Wall thickness 0 = solid (e.g. wire or rod). Corners of the path are rounded.
Wie in Fusion: ohne „Modelliert“ wird da: As in Fusion: without “Modeled” the thread is only displayed (fast). When modeled, the thread form is actually cut, e.g. for 3D printing. Hole for M8 = Ø6,8.
Importierte Körper sind ohne Konstruktio: Imported bodies have no design history but can be edited further (fillet, chamfer, cut …) and used for CAM. “Y axis up” puts models from programs with Y pointing up the right way.

Kopien von „{0}“; Gelenke und Positionie: Copies of “{0}”; joints and positioning of the body are applied to every copy.
Während der Auswahl wird das Modell vor: During selection the model is shown as it was before this step. Click edges to add/remove.
Die gewählten Flächen werden entfernt, d: The selected faces are removed and the body is hollowed inwards.
Offene oder geschlossene Kurven werden u: Open or closed curves are revolved about the axis – the result is a surface, not a solid.
Offene oder geschlossene Kurven werden s: Open or closed curves are extruded normal to the sketch – the result is a surface (wall without thickness). “Thicken” or “Stitch” turns it into a solid.
Geschlossene Profile werden zu ebenen Fl: Closed profiles become planar surfaces – e.g. top and bottom caps, to stitch surfaces into a body afterwards.
Erzeugt eine neue Fläche im Abstand zu d: Creates a new surface at a distance from the selected faces (negative = inwards). The body remains unchanged.
Die Kanten müssen einen geschlossenen Ra: The edges must form a closed boundary (e.g. the open end of a tube). The new surface spans it – curved too. “Tangent” makes it join the adjacent faces smoothly.
Die Fläche wird über die gewählten Randk: The surface is extended tangentially beyond the selected boundary edges – at curved edges too.
Je Skizze die erste Kurve – offen oder g: The first curve of each sketch – open or closed. The curves are joined by a skin (surface without thickness).
Die Fläche wird dort geteilt, wo das Wer: The surface is split where the tool intersects it. Then click the regions to be removed.
Flächen mit gemeinsamen Kanten werden zu: Surfaces with common edges are joined into one. If the shell is closed all round, a solid results (editable as usual afterwards). Gaps larger than the tolerance stay open.
Die gewählten Flächen bekommen eine Dick: The selected faces get a thickness along their normals – curved faces too. Adjacent faces are joined into one piece.
Verbindet die größten geschlossenen Prof: Connects the largest closed profiles of the selected sketches (e.g. rectangle at the bottom, circle at the top).
Das Profil wird entlang einer Linie/eine: The profile is swept along a line/polyline. Best draw the profile normal to the start of the path (e.g. profile on XZ, path on XY).
Neigt senkrechte Seitenflächen um den Wi: Tilts vertical side faces by the angle (pull direction +Z), e.g. for molds. A negative angle tilts the other way.
Teilt den Körper an der Ebene in zwei Kö: Splits the body at the plane into two bodies.
Zeilen laufen in Y-Richtung, Spalten in: Rows run in Y direction, columns in X direction. Height = Z of the surface at the control point.
Geschlossen: Laschen an zwei Nachbarkant: Closed: flanges on two adjacent edges run up to the bisector of the corner and leave the gap there. The corner relief sits where the bend zones cross – in the flat pattern and in the bent part.
Biegewinkel ° (+ gleiche Richtung wie di: Bend angle ° (+ same direction as the first bend, − opposite direction)
Lasche an Lasche: Winkel + biegt in dies: Flange on flange: angle + keeps bending in the same direction (U channel, hem at 180°), − in the opposite direction (Z step, hat section).
